intro: An embed puts your agent on another website, for visitors who are not signed in. Here is how one is made, and what a visitor can and cannot do.
define: In the web app, open Embeds and press New embed. It opens a page of its own. Give it a name, a title and a welcome message. The preview is the real widget, and it follows every change you make.
limits: Tick only the tools a visitor may use. Everything unticked is off. Then list the websites that may show the chat. A wildcard is refused, and at least one website is required.
snippet: Save it, and the same page becomes the edit of your embed, with the snippet to paste: plain HTML, an iframe, a web component, or curl. Copy puts it on your clipboard.
visitor: On the docs site, the chat bubble appears. A visitor asks a question, and the answer streams in, using only the tool the embed lists.
counters: Back in the web app, open the embed from the list. The counters show what happened, as real numbers. Rotate the key to end every open session, then go back to the list with the link at the top.
list: The page is the list of your embeds. Search by name or website, and filter by on, off or expired. The switch turns an embed off at once, and visitors are answered as if it never existed. Delete removes one for good, and asks first.
outro: That is an anonymous docs agent. The tool list, the limits and the allowed websites are what protect it.
